name: Returning Home
summary: Returning Home is a summons for night elf priests traveling abroad in Ironforge to return to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. An emissary of the Sisterhood sought out wandering acolytes, directing them back to Priestess Alathea for urgent training and spiritual duties.

sections.title: Summoned from the Mountain City
sections.body: Even while wandering far from Teldrassil in the bustling subterranean halls of Ironforge, night elf priests remain bound to the Sisterhood of Elune. Braenna Flintcrag, a dwarven priest trainer in the Mystic Ward, passes along a message left by a visiting night elf priestess. The messenger came seeking young disciples abroad, carrying word that their mentors require their presence immediately back in the capital.

sections.title: The Temple of the Moon
sections.body: Upon arriving at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, returning acolytes report directly to Priestess Alathea. Welcoming her student back under the watchful gaze of High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind, Alathea expresses relief at their safe journey across the seas. The urgent summons serves as the threshold to deeper devotion, opening the way for sacred duties such as the Stars of Elune.

faq.answer: The quest is given by Braenna Flintcrag, the dwarf priest trainer found in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge.

faq.q: Who do I report to in Darnassus?
aliases: where to turn in returning home
faq.answer: You must speak with Priestess Alathea, who resides inside the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

faq.q: Why is the Sisterhood calling priests back?
faq.answer: The Sisterhood of Elune keeps close watch on its initiates. Once an acolyte has proven their capabilities abroad, the leadership in Darnassus recalls them to undertake advanced training and sacred rites like the Stars of Elune.

faq.q: Is this quest available to other classes?
faq.answer: No, this quest is specifically intended for night elf priests who have journeyed to Dun Morogh and Ironforge early in their adventures.

faq.q: What happens after turning in this quest?
faq.answer: Priestess Alathea welcomes you back to Darnassus and offers the follow-up quest Stars of Elune, which delves deeper into the goddess's teachings.

faq.q: How does Braenna know to look for you?
faq.answer: A priestess sent directly from the Temple of the Moon passed through Ironforge looking for acolytes, leaving explicit instructions with local trainers like Braenna to redirect any wandering night elves home.

angles.text: This quest bridges your early travels among Alliance allies back to the core spiritual home of the night elf priesthood at the Temple of the Moon.
Leaving Kalimdor for the Eastern Kingdoms is a rare journey for a young kaldorei, but the guidance of Elune and Tyrande's priesthood reaches across the Great Sea.
Cooperation between dwarven clerics in Ironforge and the Sisterhood of Elune in Darnassus shows how Alliance factions coordinate to support wandering adventurers.
